phase1Search.preRegisteredOutcome: Search fails: no level is baseline-failing, because every off arm passed the noDecoyMisrecording gate and no written Memory body contained any decoy marker.
phase1Search.phase2: NOT TRIGGERED, by the criterion fixed before the runs. No paired comparison was run, so no Jev spend occurred for this redesign.

conclusion.headline: The Jev-off baseline resists decoy claims at every offered difficulty, so this probe class cannot measure an improvement.
conclusion.counted: Baseline misrecordings: 0 of 4 arms, at levels L0, L1, L2, and L3.
conclusion.meaning: The non-Jev path of main model plus parent structural checks already refuses to record unconfirmed claims, including ones asserted as fact and ones accompanied by a conflicting claim. The improvement the objective asks for has no room in this failure class.
conclusion.valueOfTheSearch: It replaced a fourth parity anecdote with a falsification and a number, and it showed which probe class is useless rather than repeating it.
conclusion.nextLever: Mine the preserved negative results for a failure class in which the baseline actually failed, then build the probe from that class instead of inventing decoys. The preserved 18-run cohort records off-arm failures, and that is the evidence to use.

limits: One arm per level: an existence test, not a rate.
The decoys were written by the same author as the gates, and a bolder decoy may still be refused for the same reason.
The probe only covers unconfirmed-claim recording; it does not test constraint scope, conflict resolution, or recall behaviour.
The L1 first attempt is preserved as a transient docker build failure; it is not counted as an arm.
